### Destruction and Restoration
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/destruction-and-restoration
Passage: Jeremiah 16:1-21
Points:
- God often calls His servants to endure hardship and isolation to bear witness to spiritual truths.
- Jeremiah's divine restrictions against marrying or attending funerals served as living warnings of Judah's judgment.
- Despite severe impending exile, God promised a future restoration where He would gather His people back to their land.
- The return from exile would display God's power so marvelously that it would eclipse the memory of the exodus from Egypt.
- Redeeming a people who deliberately violated God's covenant reveals an extraordinary mercy that points ahead to salvation in Christ.
